E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.caveat: torch's go5 legs and this round's jammi round5_out legs load DIFFERENT shared LoRA weight files (different seeding runs) and measure a DIFFERENT metric (full trainable-gradient cosine vs per-layer activation-gradient cosine) -- not directly cross-comparable point-for-point. This is a proxy answer, not the full E3 table the dispatch specified.
E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.reasoning: torch's own production bf16 attention path (SDPA -> FlashAttention-2 on sm80, per sdp_utils.cpp's priority_order) reaches only cos=0.817 vs its own F32 truth -- NOT 0.99+. jammi's flash arm (round 5's E2, same underlying FA2 mechanism, real vendored kernel) lands in a comparable range (boundary[1-18].cos=0.75, qkv[0-18].cos=0.85). This suggests the RESIDUAL divergence after fixing the F32-logits mechanism is substantially INHERENT to bf16 LoRA fine-tuning at this checkpoint/scale, not a further jammi defect -- while the GAP BETWEEN jammi's non-FA2 arms (fused/shared, cos 0.35-0.74 in the same zone) and jammi's FA2 arm / torch's own bf16 ceiling (cos 0.75-0.92) IS jammi-specific and IS what the F32-logits mechanism (E2) closes.
